usage: unknown command. use help for the list.

exit / q
leave readyfs for basic.

help [command] / h
show usage; aliases work: h ls.

probe [all|uci|udos|softiec|recover]
probe iec n: detects a drive safely.

profile iec n: [op] / pf
show the probed driver and permissions.

native op path [dest] / nt
show native path translation only.

drives / dv
list listeners + last readyfs mounts.
paths may have changed elsewhere.

pwd / pw
print the current absolute directory.

history / hi
list commands. up/down recalls them.

clear / cl / cls
clear the display.

cd path
set current path; cd .. goes up.

alias [name path] / al
list or set alias. al lab u:/usb1/lab

unalias name / ua
remove a saved path alias.

config save|load [path] / cf
save or restore aliases and profiles.

dir [path] / d / ls
quoted names, types and disk blocks.
host size ? means not supplied.

tree path [-i p -x p] / tr
walk nested folders. tree @lab:/

stat path / st
show metadata and endpoint capabilities.

volume [path] / vl / free
show space information when supported.

match pattern text / mt
test a wildcard match. match *.seq a.seq

type path / ty / cat
read text. type @lab:/notes

copy source dest [options] / cp
file dest names a file; tree dest exists.
use 8:/name, not 8:name.
verify on; --no-verify/-nv skips readback.
whatif lists selected files and folders.

move source dest [options] / mv
copy then remove verified source files.
mv @lab:/copy @lab:/moved -r -w
verify on; --no-verify/-nv skips readback.
whatif lists selected files and folders.

rename source dest [options] / rn / ren
rename on the same supported endpoint.

delete path [options] / dl / rm
remove files and folders with -r.
rm @lab:/moved -r -w previews only.
root remains; rmdir removes empty root.

compare source dest / cm / verify
read both files and compare bytes.

new path [--type seq] / nw
create empty file; refuses existing file.

write path text [options] / wr
write text; -l/--line adds newline.

append path text [options] / ap
append text; -l/--line adds newline.

mkdir path [options] / md
create one directory on a capable drive.

rmdir path [options] / rd
remove an empty directory only.

mount image drive: / mo
attach a u:/ image to an iec drive.
mount u:/folder s3: --name lab maps s3.
remembers this session; may be stale.

dismount drive: / um / unmount
detach media or a software iec mapping.
invalidates last-mount path hint.

swap drive: / sw
advance the firmware disk-swap list.
invalidates last-mount path hint.

capabilities [path] / ca
show supported operations for endpoint.

status / ss
show the preceding command result.

find path [-i p -x p] / fi
search a tree. fi @lab:/ -i *.seq

head path [n] / hd
print first n lines (default 10).

tail path [n] / tl
print last n lines (default 10).

crc32 path / cr
read file and calculate crc32.

test / ts
run the built-in core self-test suite.
run file [args] / ru\r\nhelp batch: vars, if, goto, call.

format path --label name --id id
--disposable --apply required to format.
use -w to preview. only disposable media.

iec device: command [value]
status version config partition
save-config saves extended settings.
